units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 49:2">Gen. R. s. 49</cite> <he>מלך שהיה לו ס׳ אחד</he> (not … <he>ים</he>, … <he>יס</he>; Ar. … <he>רון</he>) a king who had an associate; <he>עשיתי … ס׳ שלי</he> I have appointed him my associate.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 78:3">Gen. R. s. 78</cite> <he>רון</he> … <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 43">Ex. R. s. 43</cite>, beg. <cite ref="O00365"><he>סוּנְקַתִּדְרוֹ</he></cite> his associate regent. Tanḥ.

<cite ref="Exodus 5">Mishp. 5</cite> <cite ref="O01490"><he>סקנדרוס</he></cite>; ed. Bub. 3 <cite ref="O00361"><he>סונדוקרוס</he></cite> (corr. acc.); a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="O01266"><he>סִנְקַתִּדְרִין</he></cite>, <cite ref="O01263"><he>סִינְ׳</he></cite>, <cite ref="O00735"><he>סוּנְ׳</he></cite>.
